rationale: The core short thesis was price trading below the 9-EMA with momentum rolling over, but the most recent candle closed back at $36.15 — above both the entry price and the 9-EMA ($36.03) — with volume picking up (7,665 shares), signaling that buyers are reasserting control and the thesis has mechanically failed. The position captured a favorable excursion of 0.70% but has fully given it back, and continuing to hold with price climbing toward the $36.70 stop risks an accelerated loss on a thin-float instrument with a wide spread. Closing here limits damage while preserving remaining daily loss budget ($877).
